Bit Slow Out Straight Out The Back Crossed Inside Settled Down 8th Inside 8 Lengths last Turning for home Never Likely bvut quickened from 100m, ran on # strong late

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Restrained Settled Down rear 10 Lengths Two Wide with cover asked to go at the 400m, clear run home Kept Finding Closest on line Sound Effort - sat too far back - and # bled

A post-race vet exam revealed mnt had bled from both nostrils. As this was the first occasion, tnr was advised of the provisions of AR79(4).
